checklist_item: Proxy: processed by FY end = available to CN
claim_as_stated: A return counts at a cut-off if processed on or before it; batch IDs give no evidence of a publication lag, and none is assumed beyond the FY-start variant.
exact_values_found: Last-Modified of 2025-26 batches: batch M posted mid-to-late month M+1 (e.g. 2025_11A 17 Dec 2025; 2026_06A 15 Jul 2026; 2026_10A 18 Nov 2026; 2026_11A not yet posted). The 2023-24 files were re-uploaded 6 Mar 2025, so their first posting dates cannot be seen. Validator sensitivity (repo script imported, availability moved): third Wednesday of the next month 72.58% (FY2023 67.99%, FY2024 76.65%); plus 63 days for CN refresh 71.50% (66.52%, 75.91%); FY start 68.83%.
discrepancies: A posting lag of about 3-7 weeks exists; the note's 'no evidence of a lag' is true of the batch IDs but not of the batch files.
contradictory_evidence: CN release notes list data refreshes about every 1-2 months in 2025-26 (e.g. 4 Feb, 8 Apr, 3 Jun, 5 Aug, 7 Oct 2025). For 2024 they list only 8 Apr, 1 Aug, 15 Nov and 15 Dec, and version numbering (19-20 in Nov-Dec 2024) shows that earlier refreshes are not listed.
interpretation_challenge: The proxy is optimistic but close: realistic lags cost 0.1-1.2 points, well inside the 68.83% day-one bracket. 72.66% should be described as an upper-leaning year-end figure.
